'''Arnthout''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], located south of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. It was a stop on the [[Circle Route]] around the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. It was named after [[Melnea Arnthout]].<ref name="GG7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The map included in the [[StarWars.com]] article ''The World of Star Wars: Kenobi'' misspells this location as "Carnthout".<ref name="TWoSWK">{{SW|url=news/the-world-of-star-wars-kenobi|text=The World of ''Star Wars: Kenobi''|nolive=1}}</ref>
